product_name: App Engine flexible environment custom runtimes

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.2+ protocol and cipher suite support for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment now supports TLS version 1.2 and later with a secure set of cipher suites in General Availability.

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.1 and earlier support deprecation for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated in App Engine flexible environment, with guidance to use TLS 1.2 and later; deprecated on 2025-03-01.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Runtime lifecycle-stage filtering for App Engine versions
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine console now allows filtering versions by runtime lifecycle stage and shows warning icons for versions nearing or past end-of-support status.

uncovered_features.feature_name: SSH access for internally addressed App Engine flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: You can now SSH into App Engine flexible environment instances that use only internal IP addresses.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Internal IP mode for App Engine flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment instances can now be configured with internal IP mode as a generally available option.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to additional locations
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-west1 (Oregon), asia-southeast1 (Singapore), and asia-east1 (Taiwan) regions.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to europe-central2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-central2 (Warsaw) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: External HTTPS load balancing via App Engine Serverless NEGs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine gained support for External HTTPS Load Balancing through Serverless network endpoint groups, enabling Cloud CDN integration.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to us-west4
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-west4 (Las Vegas, NV) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability (us-west2)
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the asia-northeast3 (Seoul) region; App Engine became available in the asia-northeast2 (Osaka, Japan) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional request URL format
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine introduced optional region-ID based application URLs to improve request routing, with a gradual rollout to existing projects.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine deployment IAM role documentation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine documentation was updated with improved deployment access-control guidance for IAM roles and service accounts.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Default gzip response compression for App Engine Flexible Environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Flexible Environment now enables gzip compression for all responses by default after you redeploy your app.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Per-second instance billing in App Engine Flexible Environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Instance billing granularity was changed to per-second increments, with the minimum charge for instance resources reduced from 10 minutes to 1 minute.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Legacy health checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Legacy health checks are being retired and are no longer available after the deprecation date; deprecated on 2018-09-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Updated health checks default for new App Engine projects
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Updated health checks became the default setting for new App Engine projects, with project upgrades possible via gcloud app update --split-health-checks.

uncovered_features.feature_name: General availability of App Engine custom domain mapping APIs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine gcloud and Admin API custom domain mapping capabilities, including domains verify and apps.authorizedDomains.list, moved to general availability.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Managed SSL certificates for App Engine custom domains
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Managed certificates became available for App Engine custom domains, with automatic provisioning, renewal, and revocation when a domain is removed.
keywords: managed cert revocation on domain remove

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in southamerica-east1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the southamerica-east1 (São Paulo, Brazil) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in europe-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west3 (Frankfurt, Germany) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in australia-southeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the australia-southeast1 (Sydney, Australia) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region availability in europe-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west2 (London) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region availability in us-east4
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-east4 (North Virginia) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment general availability
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment reached general availability and supports Node.js, Ruby, Python, Java, and Go with 99.95% SLA.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment PHP 7 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The PHP 7 runtime entered beta for the App Engine flexible environment.
keywords: App Engine flexible environment PHP 7 runtime

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment configuration with env:flex
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment is selected in app.yaml using env:flex instead of vm:true.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment custom machine types
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment added support for custom machine types.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment modern networking stack
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment adopted a modern networking stack with increased throughput.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment multi-zonal deployment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment gained multi-zonal deployment support.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment region availability in asia-northeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Asia-Northeast1 region became available for the App Engine flexible environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go App Engine package compatibility
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The legacy Go App Engine package was deprecated for use with App Engine flexible environments in favor of cloud.google.com/go packages; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: java-compat runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The java-compat runtime was deprecated for App Engine flexible environments; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: jetty9-compat runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The jetty9-compat runtime was deprecated for App Engine flexible environments; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: python-compat runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The python-compat runtime was deprecated for App Engine flexible environments; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: python27 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The python27 runtime was deprecated for App Engine flexible environments; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible/Managed VM container build integration with Cloud Build
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible/Managed VM deployments can use the Cloud Build service (in beta) as an alternative container build path via gcloud deploy configuration.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible/Managed VM default container build on transient Compute Engine VM
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Managed VM and App Engine flexible deployments can build container images remotely on a transient Compute Engine VM with Docker when using gcloud preview app deploy.
